## Context / Problem
Five dated evidence/analysis files sit under `docs/` as if maintained: `docs/remediation-implementation-plan.md` (775 L), `docs/oss-comparison-and-remediation.md` (232 L), `docs/88ab-feature-branch-evidence.md` (225 L), `docs/serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample.md` (115 L), `docs/dco-rollout-evidence.md` (83 L). Each is the durable copy of a ticket trail (`88ab…md:5-7` says so verbatim). Two 13-line stubs (`docs/writing-a-passing-plan.md`, `docs/passing-code-review.md`) exist only "so existing links do not break" — the only Markdown links to them are `docs/README.md:58,74`. Six citations name `docs/designs/sync-hardening-proposal.md`, which never existed.

## Approach
1. **Post before deleting.** For each of the five files, post ONE `comment_ticket` (MCP) on its target ticket. The comment's first line is `Relocated from docs/<file> @ origin/main 66be683cc7c by E11 S1 (<this story alias>)`; the next line is the literal marker `--- verbatim copy follows ---`; everything after that marker is the file body verbatim plus one trailing newline. The marker is required: two of the five comments carry an extra operator-decision sentence between header and body, so AC1 splits on the marker, not a line offset. The five targets: `docs/oss-comparison-and-remediation.md` and `docs/remediation-implementation-plan.md` -> epic `hoary-datum-cop` (`0b32-bc94-5ea1-482a`); `docs/88ab-feature-branch-evidence.md` -> epic `elfish-chair-lug` (`88ab-7052-8850-46d4`); `docs/serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample.md` -> `84c7-ad6c-be99-4c30`; `docs/dco-rollout-evidence.md` -> `ddcd-fc9e-a81f-4cbb`. Then `git rm` the five files. `docs/dco-rollout-evidence.md:5-7` asserts its own story's AC requires the evidence "captured in-repo, not only in the ticket tracker"; that AC is retired by the same operator decision already recorded here for the serena sample, and the relocation comment must say so explicitly.
2. Update the index and the prose mentions: `docs/README.md` delete lines **58, 74, 126, 127, 135, 137, 139** — one bullet per deleted file: 58 writing-a-passing-plan, 74 passing-code-review, 126 oss-comparison-and-remediation, 127 remediation-implementation-plan, 135 88ab-feature-branch-evidence, 137 dco-rollout-evidence, 139 serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample. **Keep 67** (FP ledger, retained by decision), **136 bash-migration.md and 138 release-notes.md — both are live docs that are NOT being deleted**; do not touch the eval-harness-owned prose at 129 and 141. Delete whichever of the blank lines 128/140 the removals leave doubled. `docs/archive/README.md:11` (replace "Superseded by the durable analysis in `../oss-comparison-and-remediation.md`" with "its analysis docs are preserved as comments on epic `hoary-datum-cop` (`0b32-bc94-5ea1-482a`)") and `:13` (rewrite: "The plans it pointed at were relocated to that epic's comments; nothing living remains here."). `docs/archive/2026-06-13-oss-comparison-session-log.md:15-17` table rows → the ticket pointer (line 17's stale `docs/2026-06-13-…` path → `docs/archive/…`). `infra/gerrit/feature-branch-e2e-scenarios.sh:339` comment → `# concurrency.group cancel-in-progress (story will-tile-plum 2e8a-1a3b-66bf-4cd1 AC5; evidence comment on epic elfish-chair-lug)`. The experiments README link (`docs/experiments/README.md:4` today; relocated by the eval-harness story — locate with `git grep -n 'remediation-implementation-plan' origin/main`) → "the remediation plan is preserved as a comment on epic `hoary-datum-cop` (`0b32-bc94-5ea1-482a`)" (plain text, no link). Frozen corpora under `docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/runs/*.jsonl` are NOT edited.
3. Delete the stubs; nothing else links them (AGENTS.md already cites the packaged sources, not the stubs — `src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md` at `:225` and `src/rebar/_guides/passing-code-review.md` at `:443`; locate them with `git grep -n 'rebar explain plan' AGENTS.md` rather than by line. `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/registry.py:615-616` and `criterion-pins.json` name the packaged basenames).
4. Tests: `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_docs_enumeration_parity.py` — delete the two `oss-comparison-and-remediation.md` arms (`:103-114`), `_COUNT_ARM` (`:123-129`), `_count_word`/`_NUMBER_WORDS` (`:26-36, :83-88`), `test_relation_count_matches_its_master` (`:163-170`); rewrite the module docstring to "two enumerations across two documents". `tests/unit/test_project_symbol_reference_completeness.py:208-215` — delete `test_real_review_run_evidence_is_committed` (its AC "repo-verifiable artifact, not only a ticket comment" is retired by the operator decision; record that in the ticket comment).
5. Phantom citations this epic owns (`scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py` is NOT edited — `git grep sync-hardening -- scripts` is empty). The three live hits: `tests/unit/test_comment_hygiene_guard.py:169` docstring → "a hyphenated file name like `docs/plan-review-gate.md` must not accept a block (a phantom design-doc path masked a live raw SHA in the b047 close verification)", `:175` fixture line → `"# docs/plan-review-gate.md section 3.\nX = 1\n"` (assertion `returncode == 1` unchanged); and **`tests/unit/reconciler/diffing/test_inbound_differ_field_contract.py:46`** → `"See story a130-2b7c-429c-43d1 and the CONTRACT block in inbound_differ.py; symmetry rules live in _field_contract.py."`.

## Scope
Delete: `docs/remediation-implementation-plan.md`, `docs/oss-comparison-and-remediation.md`, `docs/88ab-feature-branch-evidence.md`, `docs/serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample.md`, `docs/dco-rollout-evidence.md`, `docs/writing-a-passing-plan.md`, `docs/passing-code-review.md`.
Edit: `docs/README.md`, `docs/archive/README.md`, `docs/archive/2026-06-13-oss-comparison-session-log.md`, the relocated experiments README, `infra/gerrit/feature-branch-e2e-scenarios.sh`, `tests/unit/test_comment_hygiene_guard.py`, `tests/unit/reconciler/diffing/test_inbound_differ_field_contract.py`, `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_docs_enumeration_parity.py`, `tests/unit/test_project_symbol_reference_completeness.py`.
Out of scope: `docs/code-review-fp-ledger.md` (kept), `src/rebar/llm/code_review/fp_ledger.py`, the two reconciler `src` citations (reconciler epic), `docs/README.md:130,142`.

## Testing
`python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check` (index membership + every relative link in `docs/`, `.github`, `.agents`, `infra/runbooks`, `src/rebar/_guides`, `templates`); `python scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py`; `python scripts/check_dco_identity.py`; `pytest tests/unit/test_check_docs_index.py::test_current_repo_index_is_clean tests/interfaces/contracts/test_docs_enumeration_parity.py tests/unit/test_project_symbol_reference_completeness.py tests/unit/test_comment_hygiene_guard.py tests/unit/reconciler/diffing/test_inbound_differ_field_contract.py tests/unit/test_guides.py tests/unit/test_guide_criterion_pins.py`; `git grep -n 'sync-hardening-proposal' -- scripts tests` must be empty.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Five `rebar show <target>` each contain a comment starting `Relocated from docs/<file>` whose body equals the deleted file (`diff <(git show 66be683cc7c:docs/<file>) <(text after the `--- verbatim copy follows ---` marker + one trailing newline)` is empty). SHA repinned (see comment).
- [x] `git ls-files docs/` lists none of the seven deleted files; `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check` exits 0.
- [x] `git grep -n 'writing-a-passing-plan.md\|passing-code-review.md' -- docs/README.md` is empty; `git grep -n 'docs/designs/sync-hardening-proposal' -- scripts tests` is empty.
- [x] `test_docs_enumeration_parity.py` collects exactly two parametrized cases (`pytest --collect-only -q`).
- [x] `docs/README.md:129` and `:141` (the eval-harness-owned prose lines; re-measured) are byte-identical to the eval-harness story's landed version (`git diff <its merge sha> -- docs/README.md` touches no line it owns).
